name: BSP_BotScheduler_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Gated on game+1FE4h being 0 or 1 and this+1498h. Think countdown at +1494h reloads from +14ACh and runs eight passes of 00911e80 then 00912a60. When the mode is not 2 and +14A4h is set, +14A0h accumulates the delta. The object is allocated 14B8h bytes at 004e3e74 with constructor 0091d640; that constructor, this routine and all four callees are in segment 59, keywords pilotbot, tailgunnerbot, torpedobot, thinktimeleft. Provisional: eight 284h records from +1E4h would overrun the 14B8h allocation, and only the first dword of each is read. docs/GAME_WORLD_ENTITIES.md.

name: BSP_MissionPlayerRecords_Reset
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. Provisional. __thiscall, ECX = *(00E188A8 + 21A0h) (004c9c20 MOV ECX,[EAX+21A0h]; the decompiler renders it as a no-argument call), no stack arguments, RET. Runs 00915760 over eight records at this+4h with stride 0x284, clears byte this+1484h, then empties the red-black tree at this+1488h/+148Ch, destroying each value through 0063ad70 with ECX = this+1488h. The pseudocode's return after free is the no-return artifact on 00BF65AC; the node loop falls through. game+21A0h is written by BSP_Game_OnInit at 004e3e9f and cleared by 004cccc0 and BSP_Game_OnDestroy, so it exists only while a mission is loaded and GGame::OnInitTitle resets it on the way back to the front end. What the eight 0x284-byte records hold is not established; 00915760 is in segment 59 whose keywords are bot AI (pilotbot, torpedobot, thinktimeleft) and its other caller is 008bc540. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md
